newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss set terms on three-month money market claims.
newsitem.headline: Swiss set terms on three-month money market claims.

text.p: The Swiss federal government seta 1.258 percent yield on a new series three-month (91-day) money market claims in a new series 3.398 to be paid for on August 7, the Swiss National Bank said.
The new series, totaling 1,104.55 million Swiss francs, was priced at 99.683 percent. Maturity is November 6, 1997.
The previous issue of 12-month claims A.397, paid for on July 31, raised 859.1 million francs and was priced at 98.418 percent to yield 1.590 percent annually.
